note: L'arbre de famille (s02maison, new zone 2026-10-22): the family-tree corner of the grandparents' parlour, olive damask and dark wainscot as in the parlour; LANDMARK the big gilt family-tree painting with portrait medallions and the open iron-bound heirloom chest. Left (no masculine words): oval portrait of an old bearded knight in armour hung on the wall (ancêtre, m/f), very tall grown-up riding boots beside tiny baby booties (parental). Masculine right: a grown friar with a big red bow on his head (beau-frère), a boy climbing down a rope ladder out of the family-tree painting (descendant), a little heir in a gold crown and furry tie cheering (héritier), a hairy long-bearded man lifting a model Taj Mahal out of the chest (héritage), a toddler banging a drum (bambin), two half-brothers, one in a friar's robe and one in a football kit (demi-frère), a sofa sawn in two with the couple sitting apart, arms crossed, saw and sawdust on the floor (divorce). No painted exit (gate 8): the Back control returns to the parlour.
